decisions.reason: As a low-cost feature tightly linked to the firm's identity and secure-service platform, it is worth keeping open because market potential is still uncertain but the downside of waiting is small.

It fits the firm's core identity-plus-payment strategy, so management would likely keep the option alive for another year even though overlap with other wallet offerings raises some rationalization risk.

Because this NFC-based authenticator looks more niche and deployment-dependent than the firm's broader platform offers, it is the most plausible candidate to abandon if early traction has not clearly validated it.

A secure payment and wallet framework directly supports the firm's ecosystem platform direction, and its dedicated market presentation suggests enough strategic importance to continue despite remaining uncertainty.
As the stated flagship for building secure multi-service apps, this is a core strategic commitment rather than a peripheral experiment and is very unlikely to be taken off the market.

The shielding library draws on the firm's long-standing security capabilities and can complement its app platform, so the firm would likely retain it as a relatively inexpensive option while demand becomes clearer.
